annotations.title: 米国の輸入の陸揚げ原価

description: 米国に輸入される建材と化学品の陸揚げ原価を HS 10 桁で返す(Census の輸入統計 IMDB、月と年初来): 通関価格・CIF・計算上の関税(232 条などの追加関税を含む)・数量・単価・実効の関税率と、相手国の上位(か country で指定の国)。単価と実効の関税率は computed:true。国内の運賃と通関の手数料は入らない。 / Landed cost of U.S. imports of construction materials and chemicals by HS 10-digit code (Census IMDB, month and year to date): customs value, CIF, calculated duty (including Section 232 and other additional duties), quantity, unit cost and effective duty rate (computed), with top partner countries or one country.

country.description: 相手国(英語の国名か Census の国コード 4 桁)。 / Partner country.

hs.description: HS の頭 2〜10 桁(例 7214 棒鋼)。 / HS code prefix.

query.description: 英語の品名。 / Product name in English.

name: get_us_import_landed_cost

outputSchema.description: 米国の輸入の陸揚げ原価。 / U.S. landed import cost by HS code.

count.description: How many records matched. 0 means the source was read and nothing matched. It never means the source could not be read, that returns isError: true.

did_you_mean.description: Near matches, when an exact match was not found.

how_to_cite.description: 引用の仕方 / how to cite

lookup.description: ok = the source was read and something matched. absent = the source was read and nothing matched. A source that could NOT be read never appears here: that returns isError: true and makes no claim about what does or does not exist.

rows.description: HS 10 桁ごとの CIF・関税・単価 / CIF, duty and unit cost by HS code

source_read.description: true on every successful result. A failed lookup does not return a result at all, so this is never false, it is declared so a consumer can assert on it.

title: Get U.S. Landed Import Cost by HS Code and Partner Country
